ad_spend_rationale.target: 40 signed family-law cases/month (vs ~20 today); geography priority Cook County, then Lake and DuPage; emphasis on contentious / high-net-worth divorce and custody
ad_spend_rationale.conservative_basis: Firm's own observed yield: ~20 signed cases on $5K-$10K/mo (midpoint $7.5K = ~$375 per signed case) x 40 cases = $15,000. Risk: that yield is LSA-driven and may include referral/organic cases, and higher-value HNW targeting typically costs more per lead.
ad_spend_rationale.aggressive_basis: Reverse math on client-facing Family Law CPL midpoints: 40 cases / 15% default close rate = ~267 leads/mo x ~$87 blended CPL (mix Google PPC 40% @ $100, LSA 30% @ $80, Meta cold 20% @ $85, Meta retargeting 10% @ $57.50) = ~$23,100, rounded to $23,000. Close rate and case value not stated on call (defaults used; disclose).
ad_spend_rationale.cap_note: Paid Ads Starter ad spend cap is $20,000/mo — $23,000 exceeds it (10% overage fee or move to Paid Ads Growth $4,497/mo, cap $50K — seller to decide).
